text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the Japan Cup. Grass
Wonder
learns that both she and
Марузенски are
predicted to earn places
in the Arima Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The prospect of finally facing the Beast
in a
decisive showdown looms large in
her mind.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Just before the race, Грасс Вандер runs
into El
Condor Pasa. Determined to
prove that she is the
more worthy
successor to the Beast, she
accompanies
her rival to the track.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
